Evidence:

- All four signals drift steadily in one direction rather than cycling. That rules out a time-of-day effect. The only open work order is the E-302 fouling check, which notes a daily ambient cycle. Nothing in the 7-day work order list explains this.

Recommended action: Consider switching to standby P-301B and have P-301A inspected for bearing or impeller wear. I've highlighted both pumps and proposed a P1 work order for P-301A. It is not created until you approve it.
